g.text: BENCH REVIEW ONLY - NO HUMAN / FABRICATION RELEASE

g.desc: BENCH REVIEW ONLY - NO HUMAN / FABRICATION RELEASE

g.text: Native USB on supplied kit adapter

g.desc: Native USB on supplied kit adapter

g.text: Six differential electrode pairs -> protection / RC -> ADS1296 -> SPI -> Tiny -> kit USB-C -> PC

g.desc: Six differential electrode pairs -> protection / RC -> ADS1296 -> SPI -> Tiny -> kit USB-C -> PC

g.text: ASSEMBLY: C14,C27,R21,C23 mount on B.Cu; all other carrier components mount on F.Cu.

g.desc: ASSEMBLY: C14,C27,R21,C23 mount on B.Cu; all other carrier components mount on F.Cu.

g.text: Fit two 1x9 female sockets on carrier; solder male headers to Tiny, then plug it in.

g.desc: Fit two 1x9 female sockets on carrier; solder male headers to Tiny, then plug it in.

g.text: Preserve the blank masked area beneath Tiny underside test pads; no exposed vias/pads there.

g.desc: Preserve the blank masked area beneath Tiny underside test pads; no exposed vias/pads there.

g.text: Four copper layers; In1 GND reference. Passives remain 0805 or larger; allow two-sided assembly.

g.desc: Four copper layers; In1 GND reference. Passives remain 0805 or larger; allow two-sided assembly.

g.text: ADS1296 TQFP64 remains 0.5mm pitch: use magnification,flux and bridge inspection.

g.desc: ADS1296 TQFP64 remains 0.5mm pitch: use magnification,flux and bridge inspection.

g.text: CapFix: C22,C10,C14,C20,C27 meet <=2mm; R21 meets <=3mm to the specified U1 pad centres.

g.desc: CapFix: C22,C10,C14,C20,C27 meet <=2mm; R21 meets <=3mm to the specified U1 pad centres.

g.text: These are independently checked XY centre distances; underside placement adds board thickness and vias.

g.desc: These are independently checked XY centre distances; underside placement adds board thickness and vias.

g.text: See SIX_TARGET_VERIFICATION.json for final-board hash,trace lengths,series vias and local ground returns.

g.desc: See SIX_TARGET_VERIFICATION.json for final-board hash,trace lengths,series vias and local ground returns.

g.text: Values and footprints retained. Bench prototype: no physical noise,RLD-stability or USB test performed.

g.desc: Values and footprints retained. Bench prototype: no physical noise,RLD-stability or USB test performed.
